items.title: File Einspruch against the 2024 income tax assessment
items.quote: Für den Einspruch haben Sie einen Monat Zeit; die Frist läuft ab dem Ende des Tages, an dem der Bescheid als bekannt gegeben gilt.
items.computation: Document is dated 23.04.2025 (Wed); assuming it was also posted that day. Current § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO deems a letter sent by post within Germany delivered on the 3rd day after posting (the letter itself wrongly states the 'vierte Tag' - this contradicts current law and is flagged as a warning; the legally correct 3rd-day rule is applied instead). 23.04.2025 + 3 days = 26.04.2025, which is a Saturday. Under settled case law (applying § 108 Abs. 3 AO analogously to the delivery fiction), if this fictional delivery day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, delivery is deemed to occur on the next business day: Monday 28.04.2025. The one-month Einspruchsfrist (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) then runs per §§ 108 Abs.1 AO, 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of deemed delivery (28.04.2025) is not counted for the start, but the one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 28.05.2025 (Wednesday). 28.05.2025 is a regular business day in NRW (not a holiday, Ascension Day falls on 29.05.2025), so no further shift is needed.

items.computation: The letter only states the refund of 425,00 € will arrive 'in den nächsten Tagen' (in the next few days) after the letter's date of 23.04.2025, without giving a specific date, so an exact due date cannot be determined.

warnings: The letter's Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung states delivery is deemed on the 'vierte Tag' (4th day) after posting, but the current statutory rule under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO is the 3rd day after posting; the Einspruch deadline above was computed using the legally correct 3-day rule, which is one day earlier than the letter's own wording would suggest.

The exact date the letter was actually posted (Tag der Aufgabe zur Post) is not stated separately from the document date; it was assumed to be 23.04.2025, which could shift the deadline if posting occurred later.
